<div class="card-body">
'''Luke Skywalker''' is the Japanese-language [[Premiere (Japanese)]] printing of [[Luke Skywalker]].<ref name="encyclopedia">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41 and 99 (index 4046). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref>


<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">ルーク・スカイウォーカー</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">タトゥイーン以外のロケーションにルークがいる場合、毎ターン、フォースを１多く起動できる。操縦する宇宙船の戦闘力に＋３。レッド５を操縦する場合、さらに回避値に＋２。耐：損耗＜３。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-luke-skywalker-Face.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">アナキン・スカイウォーカーの息子。オビ＝ワン・ケノービの弟子。Ｔ－１６スカイホッパーに乗って、ベガーズ・キャニオンのウォンプ・ラットを狙い撃ちして操縦技能を磨いた。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Luke Skywalker.

'''Card text:''' While Luke is at a location other than Tatooine, you may activate 1 additional Force each turn. Adds 3 to the power of a starship he pilots. When he pilots Red 5, also add 2 to maneuver. Immune to attrition less than 3.

'''Lore:''' Anakin Skywalker's son and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]'s apprentice. He honed his piloting skills by shooting womp rats in Beggar's Canyon from his T-16 skyhopper.
